facts.business: Asian Hotels (North) Limited operates in the hospitality industry, owning and managing hotels in India.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty related to Going Concern: The Company has loss before exceptional items and tax during the year ended 31 March 2026 and current liabilities exceeded current assets as on 31 March 2026. Emphasis of Matter: Default in repayment of principal and interest with respect to borrowings and issuance of fresh equity shares on preferential basis utilized for repayment of aforementioned borrowings.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to losses and current liabilities exceeding current assets
Default in repayment of borrowings (principal and interest)
Significant ongoing litigation and claims relating to direct tax, indirect tax, and other legal matters
Dependence on domestic tourism and business travel demand
